description: Known access routes per issuer, shared by every collector. When an issuer blocks or redirects automated clients, the working route is recorded here once instead of being rediscovered in each collector.

vaneck.note: The French gate redirects US-based runners to the US site; Dutch and UK routes remain the defaults. The Danish GDIG route was independently qualified in GitHub on 2026-10-23 (run 40002490699), with exact ISIN, currency, dates and seven official calendar return checks. This document override does not extend the qualification to other funds.

wisdomtree.note: The primary product route may answer HTTP 403. Irish and Dutch routes are bounded transport candidates for the same exact product; identity, base currency, listing currency, dates, weights and full-portfolio checks still qualify every response. Dataspan factsheets remain independent documents.

blackrock.note: Full holdings components exceed the characteristics download limit; request only fund facts and listings.

bnp.note: BNP-authored exact-share factsheets are discovered from a public document mirror (analizy.pl); the mirror is disclosed in every field's provenance and its page metrics are never used (see collect_bnp_etf.py).

landg.qualification: Exact embedded shareClassId/ISIN/USD Acc/launch and NAV header; full CSV bound to the same-date current catalogue NAV, all completed annual calendars checked. Exclude issuer pre-launch rows, never infer a launch from the first CSV row.
landg.access: Public fund-centre export linked by the publisher client. A generic HTTP200 catalogue without static-data is not a share identity. Use the exact direct document route without a cookie-jar regional redirect.
landg.reuse: Existing publisher conditions apply; HTTP access is not a licence; reuse authorisation not independently verified.
